in_marathi.name: Kshirsa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Derived from the word ‘kshira’ meaning ‘milk’.
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshirsa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kshirsa refers to a celestial being born from the ocean of milk. He is a symbol of divine nectar, purity, and prosperity.
